issue.title: Table: virtualized rows re-render on every scroll since 1.4.0
issue.author: emil
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- Vue: 3.5.13

### Description

Since upgrading from 1.3.2 to 1.4.0, every rendered row of a virtualized `UTable` re-renders on each horizontal scroll. On 1.3.2 a horizontal scroll re-rendered no rows.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/emil/acme-table-virtualize-rerender
